answer: In an economy of AI agents, a Sybil resistance mechanism utilizing Yarrow's ferrous hash function can mitigate fake-identity attacks. Each agent generates a unique, delta-weighted hash of its history, which is then hashed with Yarrow's ferrous hash. This produces a distinct, agent-specific identifier. An attacker attempting to create multiple identities must pay a fee proportional to the computational cost of generating the delta-weighted hashes, rendering the fake-identity attack economically unviable.
